findings.text: the docstring cross-reference named :func:reckon.sprint_liveness.focus_sprint_id points at nothing - focus_sprint_id is defined at reckon/project_state.py:1246 and reckon/sprint_liveness.py defines no such symbol - so the one rule the docstring defers to cannot be reached from it.

the section 4 heading still reads that the focus cost is the blocker while the evidence record it links was updated at d4b764ea to a complete verdict, so the plan page and its record disagree about the node's state; the manifest's follow_ons discloses the disagreement rather than leaving it hidden.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against be8f1330 - bec9f24a is the implementation, efbefca7 records the blocked measurement in the evidence record, the figure and the plan note, d4b764ea closes the blocker in the evidence record only; every hunk belongs to one of the three and none reaches outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: each clause is measured - the two-pointer S2 focus, the [S2, S1] order and the stored-active S1 fallback are asserted in tests/test_active_sprint_follows_live_crew.py, the gate records 153 passed exit 0 in logs/gate.txt, the declared mutation reddens exactly the live-focus test in logs/negative-control.txt, and the re-measured cost (head faster in both rounds, logs/latency-after-speedup.txt) plus the 13-before/13-after ruff row (evidence record lines 263-264) are recorded.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal - active_sprint_id follows the live sprint and live_sprint_ids is reported - is met by focus_sprint_id and live_sprint_ids in reckon/project_state.py:1211-1288, wired into both surfaces (reckon/project_state.py:1411-1412, reckon/roadmap.py:1480 and 2377-2378) and asserted end to end on both by tests/test_active_sprint_follows_live_crew.py:149-166.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the 153-passed gate at base be8f1330 plus this node's edits, the declared mutation, the closing re-measurement at the merge's two revisions, and discloses in follow_ons that the plan's section 4 note still reads blocked.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared set has seven entries (reckon/project_state.py, reckon/roadmap.py, tests/test_active_sprint_follows_live_crew.py, tests/test_sprint_push_status.py, the plan page, the archive evidence record, the figures directory); every path the three commits touch is inside it and no other path appears in their diffs.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-control.txt shows the declared mutation failing tests/test_active_sprint_follows_live_crew.py::test_focus_follows_the_live_crew_on_every_surface with assert 'S1' == 'S2' while the same file is 2 passed unmutated, so the focus guard reddens on regression; the multi-active tie-break at reckon/project_state.py:1268-1277 has no dedicated test of its own.
justifications.evidence: the gate and the mutation are on disk (logs/gate.txt, logs/negative-control.txt) and the latency re-measurement is logged with its module path pinned (logs/latency-after-speedup.txt), but that measurement logs n_live=0 in both arms so the live-path cost rests on the sibling reader node's 0.14-0.16 s reading, and the ruff row (evidence record lines 263-264) has no raw log.
justifications.fit: the helpers follow the module's docstring idiom (reckon/project_state.py:1211-1288, established by the docstring at 1246) but reckon/roadmap.py:1273 cross-references focus_sprint_id into a module that does not define it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/project_state.py:1411-1412 and reckon/roadmap.py:2377-2378 carry both fields on both surfaces, the live loop at reckon/project_state.py:1263-1266 selects on newest last_activity_at, and the fallback rule is documented at reckon/project_state.py:1246-1262.
justifications.scope_discipline: the three commits touch only the seven declared write paths and nothing else, and the figure under docs/figures/a-sprint-is-live-while-a-crew-works-it/ is the one the plan page embeds.
